children: US natural resources firm's Q3 revenue rose 5% yr/yr, operating profit up 37%
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 rose 63% yr/yr
Net income declined 18% due to higher income tax expense
Company expects full-year 2026 consolidated operating profit to be comparable to 2025
NACCO anticipates substantial year-over-year growth in full-year 2026 consolidated Adjusted EBITDA
Company expects fourth-quarter 2026 operating profit and Adjusted EBITDA could be lower than prior-year quarter
CONTRACT MINING EXPANSION - Operating profit rose due to new dragline services contract in Florida and new limestone quarry in Arizona, offsetting lower customer requirements at other sites
UTILITY COAL MINING PRICING - Improved contractual pricing and lower inventory impairment charges at Mississippi Lignite Mining Company lifted segment operating profit
SOLAR CURTAILMENT COSTS - $3.4 mln in solar curtailment costs affected results in the quarter
